owner_intent: NPCs should feel like living people with memory, relationships, goals, needs, emotions and context-aware speech; language generation is only the voice of that simulation, not its source of truth.

derived_from.external_programmer_proposal: NPC AI / LLM + memory + context + goals/needs + emotions + relationships + STT/TTS prototype in the Shire
derived_from.integration_rule: Extend the existing NPC memory/social/conversation/needs stack. Do not create a second parallel NPC brain.

existing_foundation_to_reuse: REQ-NPC-005 Living NPC goals needs emotions and character knowledge
WORK-LW-004 Offline Living NPC intelligence expansion
UShireQuestSubsystem named-NPC memory and relationship state

accepted_new_development_value.title: Optional bounded local language expression layer
accepted_new_development_value.value: A local small model may turn already-approved context into more natural wording while authored/template dialogue remains the deterministic fallback.
accepted_new_development_value.authority_boundary: The model may express facts but may not create canon facts, quest outcomes, relationships, deaths, allegiances or future knowledge.

accepted_new_development_value.title: Event and rumor propagation between NPCs
accepted_new_development_value.value: NPC A can witness a real tagged event, share that compact event tag during a valid social interaction, and NPC B may later reference it if knowledge and relationship gates allow.
accepted_new_development_value.authority_boundary: Only real registered events propagate; the model may not invent unseen gossip as factual world state.

accepted_new_development_value.title: Richer living context packet
accepted_new_development_value.value: Dialogue/behavior context should combine time-of-day, region, chapter, quest stage, completed beats, current world pressure, recent local events, relationship state, needs, goals and emotion.

accepted_new_development_value.title: Emotion-to-presentation bridge
accepted_new_development_value.value: NPC emotional state should influence dialogue style, facial acting, body language, idle choice and later voice delivery without changing mandatory story outcomes.

accepted_new_development_value.title: Optional speech input/output adapters
accepted_new_development_value.value: STT can let the player speak naturally and TTS can voice validated NPC responses.
accepted_new_development_value.authority_boundary: Speech services are optional adapters; gameplay and dialogue must remain functional without network access or a vendor API.

accepted_new_development_value.title: Named Shire NPC acceptance prototype
accepted_new_development_value.value: Use one existing named Hobbit profile as the vertical slice for memory, relationship, schedule, needs/emotion, rumor propagation, bounded expression and optional speech.
acceptance_example: First meeting records PLAYER_MET and relevant location/context.
A later real local event may be remembered or learned through an allowed NPC-to-NPC social exchange.
On a later visit the NPC can react to those stored facts without exposing future story knowledge.
Save/load preserves compact relevant memory and relationship state.
With AI expression disabled or unavailable, authored/template fallback still produces valid behavior.

non_goals: Do not make every ambient crowd actor run an LLM or hold persistent individual memory.
Do not require GPT, Claude, cloud APIs, internet connectivity or runtime API keys in the shipped gameplay path.
Do not persist raw conversation transcripts as NPC memory.
Do not allow generated text to become story authority.
Do not let AI bypass film chronology, chapter knowledge gates, quest logic or save-state ownership.

implementation_phases.title: Vertical-slice named Hobbit
work: Choose an existing named Shire profile rather than adding a duplicate NPC system.
Expose a compact context packet from current subsystems.
Prove memory-aware revisit behavior with deterministic authored/template dialogue first.

implementation_phases.title: Optional local expression
work: Define a small local-model adapter interface behind the current bounded dialogue contract.
Use strict prompt/context budgets and output validation.
Keep generation optional, cached and immediately replaceable by deterministic fallback.

implementation_phases.title: Presentation coupling
work: Add optional TTS output adapter using only validated final text.

implementation_phases.title: Scale by NPC tier
work: NAMED_LIGHT receives smaller memory and relationship budgets.
AMBIENT_ARCHETYPE remains aggregate/lightweight and never receives per-instance persistent LLM memory.

acceptance_gates: No canon/future-knowledge leakage in scripted test cases.
No save growth beyond the bounded memory contract.
No gameplay dependency on network/API availability.
Fallback response remains deterministic and valid when the expression layer is disabled.
Named Shire prototype survives save/load and chapter-state transitions.
Performance is measured before scaling beyond the prototype.
manager_instruction: Preserve this roadmap as an accepted owner development direction. Schedule it alongside existing living-NPC work when dependencies permit; do not let it block unrelated world/character production and do not re-implement systems that already exist.
